theme_strategy.rationale: High-density auction intelligence and bid history analytics excel in dark mode (#0B0F17 base) with high-contrast indicator accents, providing command-center readability for live auctions.

layout_and_grid.container_padding: px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto
layout_and_grid.grid_structure: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6

header_navigation.bg_class: bg-slate-900/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-800 sticky top-0 z-50
header_navigation.branding: Auktionsbevakning.se with live status beacon badge (Övervakar 9 källor)
header_navigation.quick_actions: Lägg till bevakning (URL/Sök), Källfilter dropdown, Sortering

add_monitoring_modal.title: Bevaka ny auktion
inputs: Auktions-URL (klistra in länk från PS Auction, Klaravik, Blinto m.fl.)

elements: Objektbild med countdown-timer badge i hörn ('Slutar om 02h 45m')
Nuvarande bud (SEK) + antal bud count badge
AI-Värderingsindikator ('Nypris est. 120 000 kr | Begagnat est. 65 000 kr')
Snabbknappar: Visa historik, Öppna originalauktion, Radera bevakning

bid_history_graph.visuals: Gradient fill under curve, custom active tooltip showing timestamp, bidder pseudonym, and step increment

components: AI Värderingskort powered by Emergent Universal Key
Jämförbart nypris (Prisjakt.se matchningar med klickbara länkar)
Senaste avslutade auktioner på liknande modeller
Prisanalys insikt i klartext (svenska): 'Budet ligger 18% under marknadsvärde. Bra köpläge.'

total_price_calculator.formula: Slutpris = Nuvarande bud + Moms (25% om ej angivet) + Köparavgift/Inropsavgift
total_price_calculator.interactive_breakdown: Toggle för moms-visning (Exkl. moms / Inkl. moms) och specificerad köparavgift i SEK

testing_and_accessibility.wcag_compliance: AA rating, APCA contrast target > 60 for body text on dark cards

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React JS and Tailwind CSS with components from src/components/ui.
Ensure all user text is in Swedish (sv-SE).
Support monitoring for all 9 sources: PS Auction, Klaravik, Blinto, Tovek, Netauktion, Retrade, Budi, Fabeo, Kronofogden.
Implement data structures containing: source, id, title, current_bid, bid_count, currency, vat, buyer_fee, total_now, ends_at, url.
Include real web-scraping / backend endpoints with fallback realistic mock data when needed.
Integrate the Emergent Universal Key AI price evaluation agent for comparing new price (Prisjakt/Google) and estimated used price.
Ensure every interactive element has a data-testid attribute for automated testing.
